notes: Cleaner Timeline layout + clearer timeline blocks. (1) The Timeline layout now hides the content rail and the inspector, leaving a centred preview above the full-width multi-track timeline — a clean whole-video overview. Scene Editor still shows the full editing panels. (2) Timeline blocks now read as distinct CapCut-style cards: each scene clip and channel bar gets a 1px dark ring + soft drop shadow, the gap between scene clips widened from 2px to 4px, and the Voice / Text / Media track lanes are more separated (bigger gap + a slightly stronger lane background).
